minimax-m3.source: MiniMax API docs (platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/models-intro): only MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is described as having 'tunable thinking depth'; MiniMax-M3 is listed without it, and the text-generation page documents reasoning_effort for M3.1-Flash only. Recording the family ladder low/medium/high that commandcode-goat-provider uses for M2.5/M2.7/M3 rather than inventing a wider one.

qwen3.7-plus.source: Alibaba Model Studio deep-thinking docs (help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/deep-thinking): qwen3.7-plus is hybrid thinking with thinking on by default; length is steered with enable_thinking / thinking_budget, and reasoning_effort is named as the knob without a published value list. Conservative low/medium/high, matching commandcode-goat-provider for Qwen/Qwen3.7-Plus.

qwen3.8-flash.source: Alibaba Model Studio deep-thinking docs list qwen3.8-flash as hybrid thinking (on by default) in the same Qwen3.8 line as qwen3.8-max; pi-ai openrouter:qwen/qwen3.8-max-0902 carries an explicit thinkingLevelMap of low/medium/high/xhigh (max:null). models.dev provider opencode-go shows low/medium/xhigh — it lacks 'high' for the high:null data-entry reason commandcode-goat-provider documented.

qwen3.8-max.source: Same Qwen3.8 line as qwen3.8-flash: pi-ai openrouter:qwen/qwen3.8-max-0902 explicit thinkingLevelMap low/medium/high/xhigh (max:null); Alibaba deep-thinking docs list qwen3.8-max as hybrid thinking with thinking on by default. models.dev opencode-go lists low/medium/xhigh, missing high for the same data-entry reason.

kimi-k2.7-code.source: Moonshot Kimi API docs (platform.kimi.ai/docs/guide/use-kimi-k2-thinking-model): kimi-k2.7-code has thinking always on (thinking.type accepts only "enabled") and its reasoning_effort column reads 'Not supported' — only kimi-k3 takes low/high/max. There is no ladder to expose, so the picker stays off and the gateway default applies.

longcat-2.0.source: Meituan publishes no rung list for LongCat 2.0; pi-ai openrouter:meituan/longcat-2.0 has reasoning:true with no map (generic default) and models.dev opencode-go offers only a reasoning toggle. Conservative low/medium/high, as recorded in commandcode-goat-provider for the same upstream model.

longcat-2.5-preview-free.source: Preview build in the LongCat 2.5 line; no vendor rung list published and models.dev opencode-go exposes a reasoning toggle only. Carrying the LongCat 2.0 family ladder low/medium/high.

mimo-v2.5.source: Xiaomi MiMo family ladder (mimo.mi.com docs: reasoning.effort controls depth, none closes thinking) as recorded in commandcode-goat-provider for xiaomi/mimo-v2.5; pi-ai xiaomi has reasoning:true with no map and models.dev opencode-go exposes no effort options.

mimo-v2.5-pro.source: Same MiMo family ladder as mimo-v2.5 (Xiaomi docs reasoning.effort low/medium/high, none disables); recorded identically in commandcode-goat-provider for xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro.

mimo-v2.6-flash.source: Owner's curated ladder for mimo-v2.6-flash (DSH plugin commit df6c41d, 2026-09-25) plus the Xiaomi MiMo docs reasoning.effort low/medium/high; pi-ai xiaomi:mimo-v2.6-flash is reasoning:true with no map.

mimo-v2.6-pro.source: Same Xiaomi MiMo ladder as mimo-v2.6-flash (owner curation df6c41d + vendor docs reasoning.effort low/medium/high); recorded identically in commandcode-goat-provider for xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro.
